ns2:course.label: Advanced Design in NPRE
ns2:course.description: Classroom exercise in the conceptual design of a nuclear engineering system involving a synthesis of previous learning in the field of nuclear engineering and related disciplines. The design includes all necessary ingredients for the system, such as core, thermal-hydraulics, shielding, material selection, and control. Prerequisite: NPRE 448 and NPRE 501.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Nuclear, Plasma, & Rad Engr department.
